entities.summary: The Château de La Clayette is a 14th- and 19th-century castle in the French town of La Clayette, situated in south-western Burgundy, in the north of the historical province of Beaujolais. It is a listed historical monument. Château de La Clayette is a château from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
